media.caption: A foreign royal image, conventionally dated about 1375. Crown, staff and gold foreground rulership and wealth; they do not measure a fortune or record the ruler’s appearance from life. This supplied detail is not the full atlas panel.
notice: Find the crown, staff and gold-colored round object.
Ask whose work is absent from the royal image.
The supplied detail already crops the larger atlas; no further crop or reconstructed writing is added.
media.creator: Attributed to Abraham Cresques; BnF / Gallica reproduction
media.place: Atlas made in Majorca; represents Mali within a foreign geographical imagination
media.material: Digital reproduction of illuminated parchment; supplied detail
media.representedDate: A later foreign depiction of Mansa Musa, whose Cairo pilgrimage anchor is 1324; not a portrait made from life.
media.relevance: Makes foreign royal imagery directly inspectable while separating representation from local institutions and household production.
